  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    cluster: thanos-metrics
    replica: node1
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - node1:9100
          - node2:9100
          - node3:9100
          - node4:9100
ANTRIEB_PROM_EOF
cat > /etc/default/prometheus <<'ANTRIEB_DEFAULTS_EOF'
ARGS="--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml --storage.tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus --storage.tsdb.retention.time=24h --storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=1h --storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=1h --web.console.templates=/etc/prometheus/consoles --web.console.libraries=/etc/prometheus/console_libraries --web.listen-address=0.0.0.0:9090"
ANTRIEB_DEFAULTS_EOF
umask 077
cat > /etc/thanos/objstore.yaml <<'ANTRIEB_OBJSTORE_EOF'
type: S3
config:
  bucket: thanos-metrics
  endpoint: node4:9000
  access_key: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY}
  secret_key: [REDACTED]}
  insecure: false
  signature_version2: false
  http_config:
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/thanos/objectstore-ca.crt
      insecure_skip_verify: false
ANTRIEB_OBJSTORE_EOF
chown root:prometheus /etc/thanos/objstore.yaml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yaml
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-sidecar.service <<'ANTRIEB_SIDECAR_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Thanos sidecar for Prometheus
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target prometheus.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=prometheus
Group=prometheus
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos sidecar --http-address=127.0.0.1:10902 --grpc-address=0.0.0.0:10901 --prometheus.url=http://127.0.0.1:9090 --prometheus.ready_timeout=5m --tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yaml --shipper.upload-concurrency=2
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
LimitNOFILE=65536
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/prometheus

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_SIDECAR_UNIT_EOF
promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable prometheus.service
systemctl restart prometheus.service
systemctl enable --now thanos-sidecar.service
sleep 2
systemctl is-active prometheus.service
systemctl is-active thanos-sidecar.service
